description: Get execution logs for a solution — recent jobs with step traces, tool calls, errors, and timing. Essential for debugging what actually happened during skill execution. (Advanced.)

actor_id.description: The actor whose job this is. REQUIRED for per-job detail: a job belongs to an actor and Core refuses the detail endpoint without one (the list form does not check). Use the same actor_id you passed to ateam_conversation.

chain_id.description: The CHAIN id — what ateam_conversation returns and ateam_chain_status takes. Prefer this: it is the id you actually hold. Resolved to the underlying job for you.

job_id.description: Optional: get detailed trace for a specific job ID

skill_id.description: Optional: filter logs to a specific skill

name: ateam_get_execution_logs
